links.fact: Oxford Ionics is an IonQ company and claims a 99.99% two-qubit fidelity world record as of October 2025

links.name: DEPRECATES
links.fact: NIST deprecation of elliptic-curve cryptography (ECC) begins in 2030

links.name: REDUCES_RESOURCE_ESTIMATES_FOR
links.fact: Google Quantum AI published reduced resource estimates for elliptic-curve breaking, contributing to cryptanalysis that raised the CRQC threat timeline estimates

links.name: AUTHORIZES_REPROGRAMMING_FOR
links.fact: H.R. 6213 would have let DOE, NSF and NIST reprogram $1.1 billion of previously authorized amounts; it lapsed without enactment

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: BCG's assessment of full fault tolerance after 2040 contradicts and tempers IonQ's 2028 cryptographic-relevance claim

links.name: LOCATED_IN
links.fact: IBM Quantum Starling is to be built in Poughkeepsie, New York

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: GRI threat-timeline series tracks CRQC probability that NIST's 2035 rationale anticipates [S5][S120]（sign=+，strength=0.4，valence=directional，polarity=0.40）

links.name: USES
links.fact: Helios has demonstrated 48 fully error-corrected logical qubits at roughly 2:1 physical-to-logical encoding under the Iceberg code

links.name: COMPETES_WITH
links.fact: IonQ's June 2025 roadmap claims ~1,600 logical qubits at ~10−7 error by 2028 while QuEra targets 1,000+ logical qubits in 2028/29, competing on aggressive fault-tolerance timelines.

links.name: FUNDS
links.fact: 2016 quantum megaproject; NLQIS established 2017 under Pan Jianwei [S64]（sign=+，strength=0.9，valence=allied，polarity=0.90）

links.name: DEVELOPED
links.fact: QuEra's analog Aquila machine provided 256 physical atoms in November 2022.

links.name: SUPPORTS
links.fact: PsiQuantum received $100 million in proposed CHIPS Act incentives.

links.name: DEVELOPED
links.fact: USTC's Jiuzhang 3.0 detected 255 photons in 2023, with a 10^16-fold speedup over supercomputers claimed in the authors' own account

links.name: SUPPORTS
links.fact: The Quantum Computing Cybersecurity Preparedness Act of December 2022 reinforced National Security Memorandum 10's (May 2022) target of completing post-quantum migration across federal systems by 2035.

links.name: ADOPTED
links.fact: On 8 September 2025 the European Commission adopted a Delegated Regulation adding quantum computers, electronic components for cryogenic temperatures, parametric signal amplifiers, cryogenic cooling systems and wafer probes to the EU dual-use control list, aligning with US, UK and Japanese controls.

links.name: HELIUM_3_ALLOCATION_DEPENDENCY
links.fact: DOE Isotope Program supplies He-3 from Savannah River; commercial buyers face tight market outside federal allocation [S14][S39]（strength=0.5，valence=neutral，polarity=0.00）

links.name: PARTNERS_WITH
links.fact: National Security Memorandum 10 is reported to set 2035 as the target for completing federal migration to post-quantum standards, complementing NIST's published final post-quantum standards and draft IR 8547 transition plan.

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative independently tests whether any vendor approach, including IonQ's, reaches utility-scale quantum operation by 2033, providing an external check on vendor claims.

links.name: EXPANDED
links.fact: In June 2024 Quantinuum expanded H2-1 to 56 qubits
